target.title: fix(android): wrap large segmented controls
target.body:
[AI-assisted] ## What Problem This Solves The shared Android segmented control normally keeps every option in one equal-width row. In Settings > Skill Workshop, the five filters Pending, Held, Applied, Rejected, and All are compressed until several labels are ellipsized, making the control difficult to scan. ## Why This Change Was Made This change makes multi-row layout an explicit caller choice instead of a global shared-component policy. Skill Workshop opts into balanced rows with at most four items, while every other segmented-control caller keeps the existing single-row default. Focused tests lock both the caller opt-in and the preserved default. ## User Impact Skill Workshop shows all five filter labels across two balanced rows without truncation. Selection, enabled state, and click handling remain unchanged, and other segmented controls keep their current single-row layout unless they explicitly opt in. ## Evidence > [!NOTE] > ### Validation > > - [x] `node scripts/run-android-gradle.mjs :app:testPlayDebugUnitTest --no-daemon --rerun-tasks --tests ai.openclaw.app.ui.design.ClawComponentsTest` — passed the focused default-and-opt-in row policy tests > - [x] `pnpm android:lint --no-daemon` — passed Android and benchmark ktlint checks > - [x] `pnpm android:assemble --no-daemon` — passed and produced the current patched Play debug APK > - [x] `pnpm run native:i18n:sync` — passed and refreshed generated source-line metadata > - [x] `pnpm run native:i18n:check` — passed with changed=false > - [x] `pnpm run android:i18n:check` — passed > - [x] `pnpm run apple:i18n:check` — passed > - [x] `git diff --check` — passed > [!TIP] > ### Real Behavior Proof > > Android emulator behavior verified with the exact patched APK. > > - [x] **Environment:** The public Before and After media were captured on an Android 36 emulator from the preceding visual head; the current scope-only follow-up was verified with a fresh focused test run and an exact-head Play debug build. > - [x] **Precondition:** Open Settings > Skill Workshop where Pending, Held, Applied, Rejected, and All are available. > - [x] **Before:** All five filters were compressed into one row and multiple labels were ellipsized. > - [x] **After:** The captured patched app rendered the five filters as balanced 3+2 rows with readable labels; the current head preserves that partition through the Skill Workshop opt-in while restoring the shared single-row default. > - [x] **Result:** The demonstrated Skill Workshop behavior remains covered without establishing a global wrapping policy for other segmented controls. > - [x] **Remaining proof gap:** The current scope-only follow-up APK was built and tested but was not recaptured on the emulator.
